speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms; could you describe what these symptoms look like and how they have progressed over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Given your occupation working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, have you noticed any specific bites, puncture marks, or direct contact with insects, rodents, or reptiles? Also, could you confirm if the rash has spread to your hands or feet?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease).

The combination of a longstanding pruritic rash, sensory loss (numbness/tingling), hypopigmented macules, and specific signs of lepromatous leprosy like eyebrow and eyelash thinning, along with your history of farm and livestock work, is highly characteristic. This clinical picture requires confirmation via a skin smear for Acid-Fast Bacilli (AFB). REQUEST TEST: Skin_Smear_AFB; REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_patches_closeup.
